'''Vnals''' were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] organic constructs created by the [[Vaathkree (species)|Vaathkree]]. Also known as "'''life-towns'''", vnals were domed [[City/Legends|cities]] used by off-world visitors to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaathkree/Legends|Vaathkree]]. Vnals were partially organic, and were also marvels of [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgy]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]]. As a result, vnals were partially alive and able to communicate with their inhabitants. While they were comfortable for brief periods, most visitors were unnerved by the prospect of sleeping inside a living, breathing, building.<ref name="TLCSB" />
